about: The masters of the wiki's paintings (WebP, quality 90) and where each came from. tools/make-wiki-art.py makes the served sizes from them. Licence: every image was made on VGraphics' Recraft Pro plan (a paid plan, so the images are ours to use commercially); the Worlds outpaint used Nano Banana 2.1 through the same Recraft Pro plan. Each entry's "tall" is its own picture for portrait screens (George, 24 Oct 2026: "Make tall version for all images. Crop sucks."): the master's tallCrop strip outpainted to 9:16 with Nano Banana 2.1 in Recraft (projects https://www.recraft.ai/project/2cdd5ac9-8349-431c-9f0a-041bd2a92feb and https://www.recraft.ai/project/ace58357-e13c-4c4b-bf56-438de61d7c58), Recraft Crisp-upscaled (26 Oct 2026, project https://www.recraft.ai/project/7bc4e391-4760-4cd0-96e3-e73a4fa06e52) and composed with the crisp strip by tools/make-wiki-tall.py.

worlds.outpaintPrompt: The same calm turquoise ocean seen straight from above, continuing to the left and right edges: open water with soft wave lines and sparkles, a few small rocky islets with green trees and sandy rims, coral and reef patches, tiny white sailboats, sea turtles, and fluffy white clouds along the bottom edge.
